import ast,json,subprocess,sys,textwrap
from pathlib import Path
source=Path('/work')
module=ast.parse((source/'tests/mypy/test_mypy_plugin.py').read_text())
test=next(n for n in module.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='test_metaclass_wraps_sync_methods_and_descriptors')
code=test.body[0].value.args[1].value
target=Path('/tmp/property-metaclass-probe');target.mkdir()
(target/'snippet.py').write_text(textwrap.dedent(code))
config=(source/'pyproject.toml').read_text().replace('files = ["a_sync", "tests/mypy/cached_property_contract.py"]','files = ["snippet.py"]')
(target/'pyproject.toml').write_text(config)
result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-P','-m','mypy'],cwd=target,text=True,capture_output=True)
Path('/reports/mypy.txt').write_text(result.stdout+result.stderr)
Path('/reports/metaclass-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit_code':result.returncode,'source':code},indent=2))
